Island 2.2, design 3: the staircase

The three validated landmarks step down from the top left in book order, so each output meets the next input head on and neither join has to turn. Tokenizer's lower row, the four whole pieces of TransBERT-bio-fr's tokenizer, runs straight on through one short arrow into the first line of Pre-training's batch, level with it and as thick: the same four pieces, one word before them, the third hidden. CamemBERT's nine pieces, a row higher, point into empty paper. Pre-training's output, the corrected TransBERT-bio-fr board, drops through one short arrow onto the mascot of the same board in Fine-tuning, which takes the four task cards.

Footprint 852 × 1096 units, ratio 0.78 (width / height). Draft (r1-3/option.py), 23 October 2026.

What moved

  • (a) Tokenizer, arrangement A (stacked): scaled as a whole to 0.693 of (b)'s scale (0.277 of its native units), so TransBERT-bio-fr's row of four is exactly as thick as (b)'s lines (16 native against 23.07). Placed at the top left. Nothing inside it moved.
  • (b) Pre-training: drawn at 0.400 of its native units, moved whole to the right of (a) and down, until the first line of its upper batch is level with (a)'s row of four and starts 40 units after its last token. Nothing inside it moved.
  • (c) Fine-tuning, arrangement B (diagonal): scaled as a whole to 0.276 of its native units, so its board is 1.8 times (b)'s; moved whole under (b), its board's middle on the vertical of (b)'s board, its top ink 24 units under (b)'s lowest. Nothing inside it moved.
  • Added: two straight ink arrows with 2.1's head, one per join, and three titles in 1.1's style A. No landmark was re-laid.

The same join 1; (c) under (a) instead of under (b), so the island is squarer (no empty lower left), but join 2 is no longer a straight drop: it leaves (b)'s board downwards and turns left into the side of (c)'s board, and it lands by the caps rather than on the mascot.
